Verbatim, unmodified. Compiled without PICOJSON_USE_INT64 (that option emits an
upstream assignment-in-condition warning which -Werror rejects); JSON numbers
therefore round-trip as doubles, exact for integers below 2^53.

Used by src/core/app/hook_install.cpp to merge the remote Claude Code
settings.json. Chosen over nlohmann/json (newosp's opt-in -DOSP_CONFIG_JSON
path) because enabling that requires editing root CMakeLists.txt and pulls a
~25k-line header for one merge operation; PicoJSON is ~1k lines, BSD, and
compiles warning-clean under -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror.
